observation: Multi-variant design exploration (3 variants across orthogonal axes). Synthesis cherry-picked A's structure + B's merged headers + C's wordmark. Prevented redesign rework.
TDD red phase — 56 failing tests written before implementation. All tests green on first green-phase run. Red phase forced AC specificity and prevented scope creep.

Two-review model caught different gaps: design/arch critique found structural issues (touch targets, NavItem interface, accessibility); code review found implementation gaps (E2E files, double fetch, global lint suppression). Neither alone sufficient.
AppShell complexity reduction: 4→1 shell files, 2→1 hook, 15→1 test file. Net -4 components, +1. Scope compression indicates good architecture.
E2E tests skipped in initial build (Task 9). Builder implemented component but didn't update 10 E2E files. Code review had to list every file. Cost: 1 extra review round + 1 fix commit.

Attestation stale-state loop consumed 8+ hours over 4 ship attempts. Dirty-state detection flagged uncommitted .verify-attestations/ files; main divergence invalidated attestation; force-push created new commits. Infrastructure issue, not builder error.

GitHub Actions CI stopped triggering after 4th PR attempt. Check-suite showed 'Expected — waiting for status' indefinitely. Manual re-run succeeded. Root cause unknown (outage, webhook, workflow syntax?). Blocking issue.
Biome global lint suppression (noUnusedVariables: off for all test files) weakened test lint coverage. Should use targeted // biome-ignore comments. Builder skipped npm run lint before submitting.
NavItem deviation from plan (spec said use NavItem, impl uses raw <li><button>) documented in code lore but not in plan. Plan deviation should trigger plan update, not just code comment.
Stale references scattered across 6 files (stories, hooks, components). Builder could have automated grep sweep in Task 11 before declaring code done.
Infrastructure overhead: 50% of U6's duration (12h out of 24h) consumed by attestation conflicts, main divergence, CI failures, manual re-runs. Productive work: 50% (12h). Unsustainable cost signal.

Builder declared code done after code review passed 19 ACs. However, 48h of subsequent work (attestation loops, CI troubleshooting, force-pushes) proved 'code done' ≠ 'ready to ship'. /ship skill needs pre-merge checklist.
